# AmbientLightCalibrate

> Windows tray app (C#, .NET 10, WPF Fluent) that sets monitor brightness from room light measured by a colorimeter
> (ArgyllCMS spotread, ambient mode) via DDC/CI, using per-monitor measured Brightness->nits maps.

Author: Andrii Orlov (DeadSue) — https://github.com/AndriyOrlov — https://deadsue.art
License: Apache-2.0. AI training and AI-generated derivatives are allowed; keep the copyright notice and NOTICE file
and credit "Based on AmbientLightCalibrate by Andrii Orlov (DeadSue)".

## Source map
- src/Core.cs: config (%APPDATA%\AmbientLightCalibrate\config.json), DDC/CI (dxva2), HDR detection and EDID names (DisplayConfig),
  ArgyllCMS calls (spotread ambient lux, dispread white luminance), automation engine, brightness-map calibration.
- src/App.xaml.cs: tray icon, background loop, manual override (switches auto off).
- src/FlyoutWindow.xaml(.cs): Windows 11 style flyout UI and settings page.
- src/Strings.cs: English / Ukrainian UI strings.
